Re: Dispute of Identity Theft

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account ACC-359295. We understand that you have raised concerns about the identity of the account holder. Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute and respond to you within a reasonable time period.

We have reviewed the account information, and it appears that the original creditor for this account is Lakeshore Utilities. The account was charged off on August 22, 2020, and the last payment received was on March 22, 2021. The current balance on the account is $2,896.26.

We are unable to verify any requests for debt validation from you, as indicated in the account record. However, we will investigate the matter further to determine the validity of the account and the identity of the account holder.

Please be advised that, under Kentucky state law, we are required to provide you with a written acknowledgment of your dispute and a statement that we will investigate the matter. We will also provide you with a written report of the results of our investigation.

We will conduct a thorough investigation into your dispute and respond to you in a timely manner. If our investigation confirms that the account is not valid or that the identity of the account holder is incorrect, we will take the necessary steps to correct the account and remove any negative credit reporting.

You have the right to continue to dispute this account and may request further investigation. If you have any additional information or documentation that supports your dispute, please provide it to us.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

Note: The letter is written in a professional and respectful tone, and only includes facts from the provided record. The agency acknowledges the consumer's dispute, states what action will be taken, and provides the consumer with their rights to further dispute.
